fields.label: Notes
fields.value: Theatre Corporate was founded in 1973 by Raymond Hawthorne (known then as 'Theatre Co-Op'). The first studio production was 'The Medieval Mystery Plays' in 1973. In 1974 'Story Theatre' was first introduced to Primary and Intermediate Schools. From 1975 'Theatre in Education Company' worked with Secondary schools throughout the North Island. In February 1976 the company moved into the Galatos Street Theatre, Auckland. In 1980 'Story Theatre' and 'Theatre in Education' merged to become the 'Community Theatre Company', created to umbrella the Theatre in Education work. The company's last production was 'Hedda Gabler' in October 1986. [See Also NZMS 886, for Theatre Corporate's business records]
